top_gap_distribution.label: Top gap distribution
top_gap_distribution.description: Distribution of the gap between Top1 and Top2 within the same form, used to describe the basis for clear or close-call interpretation.
top_gap_distribution.numerator_source: The within-form Top1–Top2 gap from the public result projection.
top_gap_distribution.denominator_source: All results with an Enneagram public projection v2.
top_gap_distribution.minimum_sample_guidance: Day7 feedback samples are not required.
top_gap_distribution.privacy_notes: Only aggregate gap distributions are public; individual raw answers are not.

close_call_rate.label: Close-call rate
close_call_rate.description: Proportion of results whose interpretation scope is close-call.
close_call_rate.denominator_source: All results with an Enneagram public projection v2.
close_call_rate.minimum_sample_guidance: Long-term tracking requires stable coverage of the questionnaire.

diffuse_rate.label: Diffuse rate
diffuse_rate.description: Proportion of results whose interpretation scope is diffuse.
diffuse_rate.denominator_source: All results with an Enneagram public projection v2.
diffuse_rate.minimum_sample_guidance: Long-term tracking requires stable coverage of the questionnaire.

low_quality_rate.label: Low-quality rate
low_quality_rate.description: Proportion of results triggering the low-quality boundary.
low_quality_rate.numerator_source: Number of results where low-quality status is triggered.
low_quality_rate.denominator_source: All results with an Enneagram public projection v2.
low_quality_rate.minimum_sample_guidance: Long-term tracking requires stable coverage of the questionnaire.
low_quality_rate.privacy_notes: Uses policy outputs without retrieving raw answers.

pair_frequency.label: Pair frequency
pair_frequency.description: Frequency of close-call pairs, used to guide pair-library coverage.
pair_frequency.numerator_source: Counts of close-call pairs in classification or dynamics.
pair_frequency.minimum_sample_guidance: Long-term tracking requires stable close-call coverage.
pair_frequency.privacy_notes: Only aggregate frequencies at the pair level are reported.

top1_resonance_rate.label: Top1 resonance rate
top1_resonance_rate.description: Proportion of Day7 observations whose final resonance points to Top1.
top1_resonance_rate.numerator_source: Number of Day7 observations identifying Top1.
top1_resonance_rate.denominator_source: All observations with submitted Day7 feedback.
top1_resonance_rate.minimum_sample_guidance: Stable Day7 feedback samples are needed before publishing values.
top1_resonance_rate.privacy_notes: Only aggregate observations are counted; individual confirmations are not shown.

top2_resonance_rate.label: Top2 resonance rate
top2_resonance_rate.description: Proportion of Day7 observations whose final resonance points to Top2.
top2_resonance_rate.numerator_source: Number of Day7 observations identifying Top2.
top2_resonance_rate.denominator_source: All observations with submitted Day7 feedback.
top2_resonance_rate.minimum_sample_guidance: Stable Day7 feedback samples are needed before publishing values.
top2_resonance_rate.privacy_notes: Only aggregate observations are counted; individual confirmations are not shown.

retake_consistency_index.label: Retake consistency index
retake_consistency_index.description: Definition of Top1/Top3 consistency for the same person retaking the same form.
retake_consistency_index.numerator_source: Count of consistent pairs meeting same-form retake conditions.
retake_consistency_index.denominator_source: All Enneagram attempt pairs meeting same-form retake conditions.
retake_consistency_index.minimum_sample_guidance: Stable same-form retake samples are needed before publishing values.
retake_consistency_index.privacy_notes: Only anonymous aggregates are used; individual retake histories are not returned.

e105_fc144_agreement.label: E105 / FC144 agreement
e105_fc144_agreement.description: Definition of Top1/Top3 overlap for the same person taking E105 and FC144.
e105_fc144_agreement.numerator_source: Count of qualifying cross-form pairs with Top1 or Top3 overlap.
e105_fc144_agreement.denominator_source: All Enneagram attempt pairs meeting E105/FC144 pairing conditions.
e105_fc144_agreement.minimum_sample_guidance: Paired samples from both forms are needed before publishing values.
e105_fc144_agreement.privacy_notes: Agreement does not mean numerical scores can be directly compared across forms.

close_call_conversion.label: Close-call conversion
close_call_conversion.description: Definition of subsequent FC144 participation or Day7 feedback after a close-call result.
close_call_conversion.numerator_source: Count of close-call results followed by FC144 or Day7 participation.
close_call_conversion.minimum_sample_guidance: Stable samples of subsequent close-call activity are needed before publishing values.
close_call_conversion.privacy_notes: Only an aggregate activity funnel is examined, not individual reasons for decisions.

misidentification_matrix.label: Misidentification matrix
misidentification_matrix.description: Definition of transitions between initial Top1 and the type identified in Day7 self-observation.
misidentification_matrix.numerator_source: Paired counts of Top1 and the user-confirmed type.
misidentification_matrix.denominator_source: All Day7 observations identifying a user-confirmed type.
misidentification_matrix.minimum_sample_guidance: Longer-term Day7 sample accumulation is needed before publishing values.
misidentification_matrix.privacy_notes: Only aggregate matrices are public; individual confirmations are not.

observation_completion_rate.label: Observation completion rate
observation_completion_rate.description: Proportion of assigned observations reaching Day7 or 100% completion.
observation_completion_rate.minimum_sample_guidance: The current observation table supports computation.
observation_completion_rate.privacy_notes: Only task-completion rates are counted, not feedback text.

day7_return_rate.label: Day7 return rate
day7_return_rate.description: Proportion of assigned seven-day observation tasks with submitted Day7 feedback.
day7_return_rate.numerator_source: Number of observations with a Day7 submission time.
day7_return_rate.denominator_source: All observations with an assignment time.
day7_return_rate.minimum_sample_guidance: The current observation table supports computation.
day7_return_rate.privacy_notes: Only task-return rates are counted, not feedback text.

form_switch_rate.label: Form-switch rate
form_switch_rate.description: Definition of switching from E105 to FC144 or between Enneagram forms.
form_switch_rate.numerator_source: Count of users or attempts with a form switch.
form_switch_rate.denominator_source: All users or attempts eligible for repeated Enneagram measurement.
form_switch_rate.minimum_sample_guidance: Sufficient form-switch samples are needed before publishing values.
form_switch_rate.privacy_notes: Only aggregate proportions are public, not individual form-switch histories.

low_quality_close_call_relation.label: Low-quality / close-call relation
low_quality_close_call_relation.description: Joint distribution of low-quality and close-call policy outputs in the same set of results.
low_quality_close_call_relation.numerator_source: Cross-count of low-quality and close-call conditions.
low_quality_close_call_relation.denominator_source: All results with an Enneagram public projection v2.
low_quality_close_call_relation.minimum_sample_guidance: The current policy outputs support joint-distribution computation.
low_quality_close_call_relation.privacy_notes: Only aggregate policy distributions are examined; individual results are not extrapolated into labels.
